name: rotating-words
title: Rotating Words
description: One word in a sentence turns over to the next, like a rolling counter, a few times, then rests. The slot is as wide as the longest word (with the sentence's ending attached), so nothing around it moves.

meta.reducedMotion: The first word, still; all the words are listed for assistive tech.
meta.useWhen: The sentence really has several true endings (who you serve, what you make), and the rest of the line stays still.
meta.avoidWhen: More than one per page; endings that are adjectives about yourself ("innovative", "bold"); the hero's only message.
